Households.summary: One row per household: village, ward, head, phone, members, monthly income, debts, savings (rupees), land (acres) and survey date.

validations.message: village is not written like 'Village B' (capital letters or spaces differ)
ward is not a number from 1 to 6
members is 0 or unusually high (expected 1 to 15)
monthly income is not a number
survey date is in the future

row_checks.sql: t.household_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM {{tab:Households}} r WHERE r.household_id = t.household_id) > 1
row_checks.message: household ID appears more than once
row_checks.why: Check whether these are the same household entered twice.

row_checks.sql: t.members IS NOT NULL AND t.household_id IS NOT NULL AND t.members <> (SELECT count(*) FROM {{tab:Members}} m WHERE m.household_id = t.household_id)
row_checks.message: Members count differs from the people listed for this household in the Members tab

presets.label: Leave out households with an unreadable income or debt

Members.summary: One row per person in a household.

validations.message: sex is not Male, Female or Other
Works is not Y or N

row_checks.sql: t.household_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{tab:Households}} h WHERE h.household_id = t.household_id)
row_checks.message: household ID is not in the Households tab
row_checks.why: Check the ID against the Households tab.

questions.ask: Which villages have the most households in a poverty trap (low income, low savings, little land and high debt together): count and share of households per village. Bottom third of income, savings and land and top third of debt, worked out from the file itself
questions.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM {{table}} WHERE monthly_income_inr IS NOT NULL AND savings_inr IS NOT NULL AND land_acres IS NOT NULL AND debts_inr IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT quantile_cont(monthly_income_inr, 1.0/3) AS inc, quantile_cont(savings_inr, 1.0/3) AS sav, quantile_cont(land_acres, 1.0/3) AS land, quantile_cont(debts_inr, 2.0/3) AS debt FROM t), f AS (SELECT t.*, (monthly_income_inr <= inc AND savings_inr <= sav AND land_acres <= land AND debts_inr >= debt) AS trap FROM t, c) SELECT array_to_string(list_transform(string_split(lower(village), ' '), lambda x: upper(x[1]) || x[2:]), ' ') AS village, count(*) AS households_counted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE trap) AS poverty_trap_households, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE trap) / count(*), 1) AS percent_in_trap FROM f GROUP BY array_to_string(list_transform(string_split(lower(village), ' '), lambda x: upper(x[1]) || x[2:]), ' ') ORDER BY poverty_trap_households DESC, village

questions.ask: List the households in a poverty trap (low income, low savings, little land and high debt together) with their village, income, savings, land and debt
questions.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM {{table}} WHERE monthly_income_inr IS NOT NULL AND savings_inr IS NOT NULL AND land_acres IS NOT NULL AND debts_inr IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT quantile_cont(monthly_income_inr, 1.0/3) AS inc, quantile_cont(savings_inr, 1.0/3) AS sav, quantile_cont(land_acres, 1.0/3) AS land, quantile_cont(debts_inr, 2.0/3) AS debt FROM t), f AS (SELECT t.*, (monthly_income_inr <= inc AND savings_inr <= sav AND land_acres <= land AND debts_inr >= debt) AS trap FROM t, c) SELECT _row AS sheet_row, household_id, village, monthly_income_inr, savings_inr, land_acres, debts_inr FROM f WHERE trap ORDER BY debts_inr DESC LIMIT 200
